findings.highlight: I wake suddenly.
findings.evidenceJa: 呆然と目が覚めた
findings.governingReading: Shirou comes to in a stunned, mentally blank condition in the school corridor.
findings.explanation: Waking in a daze becomes waking suddenly.

findings.highlight: my entire body aches
findings.evidenceJa: 体はところどころがズキズキと痛んで
findings.governingReading: His body hurts here and there while the heartbeats drive stabbing pain into his head.
findings.explanation: Pain in scattered parts of Shirou's body becomes his entire body aching.

findings.highlight: By the time I reach my house, the date has changed.
findings.evidenceJa: 家に帰る頃には、とうに日付が変わっていた
findings.governingReading: By the time Shirou reaches home, midnight is already well past.
findings.explanation: Getting home long after the date had changed becomes merely arriving after the date changes.

findings.highlight: The agony of the spear tip piercing my chest
findings.evidenceJa: 包丁みたいな槍の穂先がずっぷりと胸に刺さった不快感
findings.governingReading: He remembers the unpleasant tactile sensation of the spear point, like a kitchen knife, entering deeply.
findings.explanation: The nauseating sensation of a knife-like spear tip sinking into Shirou's chest becomes generic agony.

findings.highlight: I try to shake that delusion off
findings.evidenceJa: そんな錯覚を振り払って
findings.governingReading: Closing his eyes makes Shirou feel as if the spear is still in his chest; he tries to shake off that false sensation.
findings.explanation: A lingering sensory illusion becomes a delusion.

findings.highlight: The fever and nausea abate a bit.
findings.evidenceJa: 体の熱も嘔吐感も下がっていく
findings.governingReading: Slow breathing lowers the heat in his body and the nausea; no medical diagnosis is made.
findings.explanation: Shirou's bodily heat becomes a fever.

findings.highlight: I know they're not.
findings.evidenceJa: アレは人ではないと思う
findings.governingReading: From appearance and behavior, he provisionally judges that they are not people before considering ghosts and elementals.
findings.explanation: Shirou thinking the blue and red men are not human becomes knowing it.

findings.highlight: The bell on the roof of the house
findings.evidenceJa: 屋敷の天井につけられていた鐘
findings.governingReading: The interior alarm bell attached to the ceiling rings when the bounded field detects a stranger.
findings.explanation: A bell mounted on the house's ceiling becomes a bell on the roof.

findings.highlight: if there's ever an intruder in the area, an alarm rings
findings.evidenceJa: 敷地に見知らぬ人間が入ってくれば警鐘が鳴る
findings.governingReading: The field is an alarm for an unfamiliar person entering the grounds; hostility is not part of its stated criterion.
findings.explanation: A Bounded Field that reports an unknown person becomes one that detects an intruder.

findings.highlight: the assassin will just leap right in and kill me
findings.evidenceJa: 暗殺者は歓喜のていで俺を殺しに飛び込んでくるだろう
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines his pursuer rushing in with apparent jubilation if he screams.
findings.explanation: The English preserves Shirou's fear of an immediate attack but drops the jubilation he imagines in his pursuer. This changes Shirou's perception of Lancer, without proving Lancer actually feels that delight.

findings.highlight: I've put myself in a situation where I'll so easily lose my life
findings.evidenceJa: 助けてもらった命を簡単に放棄しようとしている自分
findings.governingReading: He condemns his fear and the part of himself already trying to surrender the life someone saved.
findings.explanation: Shirou's anger at easily giving up his saved life becomes anger at putting himself in a dangerous situation.

findings.highlight: hold my hand tight over my wounded chest
findings.evidenceJa: 貫かれた胸を掻きむしって
findings.governingReading: He grits his teeth and scratches or tears at the chest that was pierced as he forces down his contemptible fear.
findings.explanation: Shirou clawing at his pierced chest becomes holding a hand tightly over the wound.

findings.highlight: I speak my incantation
findings.evidenceJa: 自己を作り替える暗示の言葉とともに
findings.governingReading: Shirou passes magical energy into the poster while speaking words of suggestion that alter himself for the procedure.
findings.explanation: The Trace words' function as autosuggestion that remakes the self is omitted.

findings.highlight: imbue as much magical energy as I possibly can into the poster to solidify it
findings.evidenceJa: ポスター全てに魔力を通し、固定化させなければ
findings.governingReading: For the poster to function against the spear, Shirou must circulate and fix magical energy throughout the entire object.
findings.explanation: Sending magical energy through every part of the poster becomes putting in as much energy as possible.

findings.highlight: Right before magical energy spreads throughout the poster and spills out
findings.evidenceJa: ポスターの隅々まで魔力が行き渡り、溢れる直前
findings.governingReading: Magical energy has reached every corner; just before it overflows, Shirou ends contact.
findings.explanation: The cutoff immediately before overflow becomes occurring before the energy has even spread throughout the poster.

findings.highlight: I don't think I can make it outside the mansion either.
findings.evidenceJa: 屋敷から出たところで逃げきれるとも思えない
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges that remaining means death and that even if he leaves the estate, he likely cannot outrun the pursuer.
findings.explanation: Doubting he can escape after leaving the mansion becomes doubting he can get outside at all.

findings.highlight: A silvery flash strikes my head from above.
findings.evidenceJa: 頭上から滑り落ちてくる銀光
findings.governingReading: A silver streak slides down from overhead as Lancer descends to skewer Shirou through the crown; Shirou rolls clear.
findings.explanation: The descending silver flash aimed at Shirou's head is said to strike it before he dodges.

findings.highlight: a point, when I can't even see how fast it moves
findings.evidenceJa: 初動さえ見切れない点の一撃
findings.governingReading: Shirou says a point attack is impossible to defend when he cannot read even its initiation.
findings.explanation: Failure to perceive the spear thrust's initial motion becomes failure to see how fast the point moves.

findings.highlight: he keeps flicking his spear at my sword without drawing back at all
findings.evidenceJa: 未だ戻しに入っていない槍の柄を剣で弾きあげる
findings.governingReading: Because Lancer is toying with him and has not yet begun the recovery motion, Shirou reflexively swings and knocks the shaft upward.
findings.explanation: Shirou knocking up the not-yet-recovered spear shaft becomes Lancer flicking his spear at Shirou's sword.

findings.highlight: while he's still confused
findings.evidenceJa: 男が怯んでいる隙
findings.governingReading: After his thrust is knocked aside, Lancer hesitates; Shirou hopes to run while the man is still recoiling.
findings.explanation: Lancer being physically checked or staggered becomes being confused.

findings.highlight: he's thrown me into the shed I wanted to reach
findings.evidenceJa: 目的地だった土蔵の壁に手をついて
findings.governingReading: Shirou collides with the outer wall of his intended destination, slides to the ground, and braces a hand against that wall.
findings.explanation: Lancer's kick throwing Shirou against the shed wall becomes throwing him into the shed.

findings.highlight: violently impales the shed's heavy door, pushing it open
findings.evidenceJa: 土蔵の扉を強打し、重い扉を弾き開けた
findings.governingReading: Shirou's knees collapse, the thrust passes over his head, strikes the heavy door, and knocks it open.
findings.explanation: The spear smashing the shed's heavy door open becomes impaling the door.

findings.highlight: He launches the spear at me.
findings.evidenceJa: 避けようのない、必殺の槍が放たれた
findings.governingReading: Lancer releases a sure-kill thrust that Shirou has no way to evade.
findings.explanation: An unavoidable killing spear becomes simply a spear launched at Shirou.

findings.highlight: I didn't even have the opportunity to be afraid
findings.evidenceJa: 大人しく怯えてさえいられず
findings.governingReading: Everything is so outrageous that he cannot submit to fear in silence; anger displaces passive terror.
findings.explanation: Anger making Shirou unable even to remain quietly afraid becomes having had no opportunity to feel fear.

findings.highlight: "Eh?" is absolutely the right word for this moment.
findings.evidenceJa: それは、本当に
findings.governingReading: Shirou can only react in disbelief; the fragmented narration marks the truly impossible appearance that follows.
findings.explanation: A broken narrative beat becomes metacommentary that 'Eh?' is the right word for the moment.

findings.highlight: steps between me and the man without missing a beat
findings.evidenceJa: 躊躇う事なく男へと踏み込んだ
findings.governingReading: Immediately after batting away the spear, the girl advances into the man without hesitation.
findings.explanation: Saber pressing her attack toward Lancer becomes stepping protectively between him and Shirou.

findings.highlight: Hard metal clashes and sparks fly again.
findings.evidenceJa: 剛剣一閃
findings.governingReading: Saber delivers one forceful sword stroke after the initial sparks.
findings.explanation: A single powerful sword flash becomes hard metal clashing.

findings.highlight: The man stomps his foot after blocking the woman's attack.
findings.evidenceJa: 現れた少女の一撃を受けて、たたらをふむ槍の男
findings.governingReading: Lancer receives Saber's blow and staggers or takes involuntary recovery steps.
findings.explanation: The English replaces Lancer's stagger with a foot stomp. Blocking the attack is a defensible reading, but the involuntary loss of balance is lost.

findings.highlight: Taking that as a sign
findings.evidenceJa: それが合図だったのか
findings.governingReading: When he reflexively covers the painful back of his hand, the narration wonders whether that was the signal for her nod.
findings.explanation: Shirou's hand movement possibly being a signal becomes Saber definitely taking it as one.

findings.highlight: Henceforth, my sword creates your destiny and our fates shall be intertwined.
findings.evidenceJa: これより我が剣は貴方と共にあり、貴方の運命は私と共にある
findings.governingReading: Saber declares that her sword will be with Shirou and his fate will be with her, forming a balanced mutual bond.
findings.explanation: The reciprocal contract vow becomes Saber's sword creating Shirou's destiny.
